summary: VCI Global Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement amending an earlier January 2026 supplement to reduce the covered securities to 63,986 ordinary shares, reflecting issuance of shares pursuant to pre-funded and Common A warrants from a January 20, 2026 securities purchase agreement with a single institutional investor. All shares covered have been sold and issued. Reverse stock splits of 1-for-60 and 1-for-15 were effected. This is a routine shelf takedown and warrant exercise disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms applicable. The filing merely updates registration coverage post-issuance.
